allowed_inference: On the constructed scalar actuator task, a trained single-FiLM world model uses context to change predictions and actions, and a train-prior RLS sequence state recovers nearly all true-context closed-loop benefit with persistence-specific negative controls.
not_established: Visual AdaJEPA, PointMaze/PushObj transfer, nonlinear or multi-factor dynamics, learned context encoders, deformable environments, episode-local TTT composition, and real-robot value remain untested.
allowed_next_action: Freeze an independent real-benchmark transfer contract, preferably PointMaze with one persistent action-calibration factor, and repeat true-context model-use plus RLS/no-persistence/shuffled/wrong controls before episodic TTT.
forbidden_next_actions: Claim that existing visual AdaJEPA already benefits from persistent context
Skip the real-benchmark true-context/model-use gate and add memory, LoRA, router, expert, consolidation, or episodic TTT
Treat the invalid unpaired-condition v1 runs as final evidence
Tune the completed V2 task, metrics, seeds, factors, or gates to strengthen the result
